purpose: Confirmatory check of the FROZEN float32 bound (results/precision_bound_frozen.json, commit 0349a1d) on designs never used to form it
never_run_seeds_note: seeds previously used in this work: 1, 3, 5, 8, 11, 21; none of the below were run
design: every seed run under both schedules; 4 runs x 36 stimuli, 20 library HRFs x 3 voxels (random amplitudes U[0.5,2] random sign, noise-free scored voxels) + 400 noise-only pool voxels; TR 1, stimdur 1
bound: frozen formula unchanged; kappa per design from X=vstack(P D(h)) in float64; maxpolydeg=round(T/60/2) as GLMsingle; n=4T, p=144
rule: any voxel with error > bound is reported as FAIL; nothing is adjusted
